purpose: Cover-production contract for Division Threshold. Issue 1 establishes the approved masthead/trade-dress pixel reference; Issues 2-8 use that exact approved image only for recurring cover-brand continuity while their own RexPrompt cover recipes control issue-specific imagery.

foundingCover.activationRule: Do not treat this path as visual authority until the Issue 1 cover is explicitly approved and the exact approved pixels are persisted at this path.
foundingCover.approvalWriteback: After approval/persistence, change foundingCover.state to approved-trade-dress-reference and status to active, then record the asset SHA if the production workflow provides one.

controls: recurring cover margins and trade-dress geometry

pixelReadGate.rule: Before generating any later Division Threshold cover, retrieve and inspect the actual approved Issue 1 cover pixels in active multimodal context. A repository path, description, hash, thumbnail metadata, remembered image, or statement that the cover was previously viewed does not satisfy this gate.
pixelReadGate.blockedBehavior: If the Issue 1 approved cover pixels do not yet exist or cannot be visually inspected, stop before later-cover generation and complete the Issue 1 cover bootstrap first.

recipeAuthority.rule: The assembled current cover recipe controls the issue-specific selling image, cast, setting, composition, spoiler ceiling, and exact required trade-dress text. The approved Issue 1 cover controls only recurring cover-brand appearance at the scope above.
recipeAuthority.conflictResolution: If copying Issue 1 composition would conflict with the current issue recipe, follow the current issue recipe and preserve only the scoped trade-dress continuity.

coverRules: One dominant selling idea per issue.
No generic cast lineup unless the current cover recipe explicitly requires an ensemble composition.
No legible environmental text or fake signage on covers.
Only exact required cover lettering from the assembled recipe may be rendered.
The cover must remain legible and compelling at thumbnail size.
Do not reveal the issue's decisive solution, late reversal, or final image.

coverDoctrine.primary: People first. Bodies first. Identity first. Society presses in around them.
coverDoctrine.commercialTest: If the masthead were removed and a reader knew nothing about Division Threshold, the cover should still make them want to know this person.
coverDoctrine.socialCommentaryRule: The political/social idea must be legible through a person's body, desire, relationship, choice, injury, self-conception or refusal. Civic systems may create pressure but must not become the cover protagonist.
coverDoctrine.materialityRule: Posthuman and transhuman bodies are materially real selves, not graphic symbols. Preserve tactile living and manufactured surfaces, heat, humidity, moisture where appropriate, scar, wear, friction, repair, weight and contact without fetishizing or using body-horror shorthand.
